 MOUZ defeated PARIVISION and reached the IEM Beijing 2026 semi-finals
 News Nov 04 
 345 views 
 3 mins read 
 Add skin.club community 
 on google 
 The Upper final of Group B determined not only the winner of the upper bracket but also a significantly more favorable path through the playoffs. One team could advance directly to the semi-finals, while the other would have to begin the decisive stage of the tournament one round earlier.
 Tournament context 
 IEM Beijing 2026 features a double-elimination Bo3 group stage. The winner of the Upper final advances directly to the playoff semi-finals, while the losing team also qualifies for the playoffs but begins in the Quarter-finals.
 MOUZ completely controlled the series against PARIVISION and prevented their opponents from taking a single map. Ancient was particularly one-sided, after which MOUZ consolidated their advantage on Mirage and secured a place among the tournament’s top four teams.

 How the match unfolded — PARIVISION vs MOUZ 
 Series score: 2:0 in favor of MOUZ
 Ancient (pick PARIVISION) — 13:2 in favor of MOUZ
PARIVISION failed to capitalize on their own map pick. MOUZ seized control from the very beginning, gave their opponents almost no opportunities to build their economy, and finished Ancient with an extremely convincing advantage.
 Mirage (pick MOUZ) — 13:9 in favor of MOUZ
On the second map, PARIVISION put up a much stronger fight, but MOUZ maintained control of the key rounds. The European roster performed more consistently in the closing stages of Mirage and closed out the series without needing to play Cache.
 Player statistics for the match // taken from HLTV Source: www.hltv.org 
 Player of the Match — Ádám “torzsi” Torzsás (MOUZ) 
 K–D: 30–16
 ADR: 71.5
 Rating 3.0: 1.49
 Key contribution: torzsi was MOUZ’s most effective player in the series and finished the two maps with almost twice as many kills as deaths. His consistency helped the team quickly establish an advantage on Ancient and maintain control on Mirage.
 VRS results 
 MOUZ — +5 pt → 1984 pt
The victory earned MOUZ five ranking points and allowed the team to retain first place in VRS. The tournament result was even more important: the roster secured a direct spot in the playoff semi-finals and avoided an additional match in the Quarter-finals.
 PARIVISION — -4 pt → 1654 pt
The defeat cost PARIVISION four ranking points, but the team remained in 11th place in VRS. At the same time, the result did not eliminate them from the tournament — PARIVISION have already secured a playoff spot and will now begin in the Quarter-finals.
 What’s next? 
 MOUZ advance directly to the Semi-finals of IEM Beijing 2026. The team skip the opening round of the playoffs and will now await their opponent, who will be determined by the Quarter-finals.
 PARIVISION also remain in contention for the title but will begin the playoffs in the Quarter-finals. For the team, this means a path to the Grand final that is one match longer, with no room for error from the very first series of the decisive stage.

 Match summary 
 MOUZ delivered a highly convincing performance in the Upper final, effectively deciding the outcome of the series on Ancient, where they allowed PARIVISION to win just two rounds. Their opponents were more competitive on Mirage, but MOUZ never surrendered control of the match and closed out the series 2:0.
 torzsi was the best player of the series with a 1.49 rating. Ultimately, MOUZ earned +5 VRS points and a direct spot in the playoff semi-finals, while PARIVISION will continue their IEM Beijing 2026 campaign from the Quarter-finals after losing four ranking points.
